title: Send an AI request
description: A developer app submits a prompt with a scoped API key.

title: Check access
description: The gateway verifies key scope, expiry and revocation.

title: Enforce the policy
description: Only approved models pass. Accepted requests use the key budget.

title: Run the approved backend
description: The gateway forwards to the fixed endpoint configured by the operator.

title: Return the response
description: The backend result returns to the app. The submission is audited.
